content.text: {"headline":"Approve R1: chat deflection, evening break shift, 5 agents moved and general coaching cancelled lifts service level to 82.2% for 15:30-19:30 at ₹615.","why":"The general-queue surge comes from the 10:15 home-loan SMS (MKT-2026-825), with loan_enquiry calls running at 2.02x normal. Doing nothing leaves the window at 78.6%, just under the 80% target, with general at 69.4%. R1 is the cheapest plan that follows policy and clears the target. It reaches 82.2% overall (general 74.2%, payments 93.5%), cuts abandons from 5.9% to 4.9%, and lifts the rest of the day to 83.0%.","trade_offs":["Cheaper options miss the target. P4 costs ₹0 and reaches 79.1%, and P1 costs ₹75 and reaches 77.2%.","P2 (85.5%, ₹540) and P3 (86.6%, ₹921) score higher but break CX-01. They use a known-issue IVR message when there is no confirmed outage, because this is a campaign surge.","R2 costs ₹1,065 and predicts slightly lower overall service (82.0% vs 82.2%). Its abandon rate is only marginally better (4.8% vs 4.9%).","Payments gives up 5 cross-skilled agents from 16:00 to 18:00 but stays strong at a predicted 93.5%. General still sits below 80% on its own, at 74.2%."],"watch":"Watch general-queue service level and loan_enquiry volume against forecast through 16:00-18:00. Check that chat deflection is actually taking about 20% of the targeted contacts. Confirm payments holds near 93% while its agents are moved."}
